title: Blind Freddy's band and the bass player Jose
summary: Nash recalls Blind Freddy's clarinet band and its instrumentation, and the bass player now in California, plus Johnnie Simmons.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What bands played in there, do you remember?

Well, you know Blind, I don't know if you all know Blind Freddy. A fellow that would go around there and play harmonica? Well, he had a band at that time, he was playing clarinet. He had a guy playing clarinet, bass player, trumpet player, trombone, drums, and piano. Yeah. They have a banjo on that band? Yeah, that's right. Tenor banjo, clarinet, bass violin, drums, and piano and trombone. Do you remember the banjo player when he was playing? The banjo player? Well, I can't remember the fellow, not so good. I can't remember. But I do remember Blind Freddy because he was born blind. I remember him very well, he played clarinet. I didn't know the bass player too, I'm trying to think of him. He left here and went to California. I felt his name and, oh geez, his name on the tip of my tongue, I can't think about it. I can't think of his name. He's in Los Angeles now, so I heard it. How long has he been gone? Oh, he's been gone about, he's been gone now about 28, he's been gone now about 27, 27 or 28 years. And he was about, he was about 60 when he left here. He was around about that age, about 60. I know that fellow named him. I'll tell you, I had his name right then. God, I know him, everybody in town knows him. He's an old bass player. He used to play up there with Blind Freddy at that time.
Jose, Jose, that's who that was. That's who that was, Jose. I was trying to think of his name. Jose's in California. That's just me.
Huh? Yeah, he's still living in California. What, you heard he's dead? No, I just wondered.
I heard he's in California playing.

Johnnie Simmons is in California too. I have his number at home. He lived on Wall Street in California. I can't think of that number. Yeah. But he do live on Wall Street, huh? That's right. That's right. I just, at home.
